usedFor: Payment teams run Akurateco steps such as “Capture Authorized Payment” and “Refund a Payment” on an authorized or settled payment.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Checkout Link” in Akurateco
bestTemplate.why: It creates a checkout session and returns a payment URL, which a later step can pass to a customer.

watchOut: “Refund a Payment” in Akurateco moves money back, so check the payment and whether the refund is full or partial.
